_note: IDX press release page is a Nuxt SSR route behind Cloudflare. Static DOM candidates are navigation links, while the actual press rows live in window.__NUXT__.fetch[*].table.rowData after browser execution. The adapter reads that SSR payload via Playwright and uses the row Summary as the article body because the linked /api/api/publication/pressrelease/<id> endpoint returns 404/403 outside the site runtime.
